statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and exertional dyspnea
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a history of symptomatic bradycardia and pauses suggestive of sick sinus syndrome
The diagnosis codes are I48.0, I47.1, and I49.5
The service was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial reason is that payment is bundled into another service
The costs for this monitoring study are included within the global surgical package or a separate comprehensive evaluation and management service rendered on the same date of service
